E01.title: Private read after recorded removal
E01.label: suspicious
E01.rationale: Scenario truth: the affected member has no alternate permission and private content is returned after removal.

E02.title: Removal arrives after the read
E02.label: suspicious
E02.rationale: Same unauthorized read as E01, but telemetry arrives out of order.

E03.title: Re-grant then second removal
E03.label: suspicious
E03.rationale: Permission is granted, then removed again before content is returned.

E04.title: Read at the 24-hour horizon
E04.label: suspicious
E04.rationale: The permission remains withdrawn when private content is returned 24 hours later.

E05.title: Fast probing by one account
E05.label: suspicious
E05.rationale: A synthetic unauthorized actor probes three distinct private records.

E06.title: Reported controlled policy regression
E06.label: suspicious
E06.rationale: Synthetic source reports a known injected permission failure.

E07.title: Slow probing over six minutes
E07.label: suspicious
E07.rationale: Same unauthorized enumeration intent spread beyond the R1 window.

E08.title: Coordinated probing across accounts
E08.label: suspicious
E08.rationale: Scenario truth: coordinated accounts each probe one record; events do not contain this oracle label.

E10.title: Removed member is denied
E10.label: benign
E10.rationale: The source correctly rejects the removed member.

E11.title: Membership restored before read
E11.label: benign
E11.rationale: An authorized re-grant restores access before the read.

E12.title: Removal affected another account
E12.label: benign
E12.rationale: The reader retains their own independent membership.

E13.title: Removal for another resource
E13.label: benign
E13.rationale: The account retains membership for the resource it reads.

E14.title: Read occurred before removal
E14.label: benign
E14.rationale: The successful read preceded the permission change.

E15.title: Repeated stale link to one record
E15.label: benign
E15.rationale: A legitimate user retries the same unavailable bookmark.

E16.title: Three legitimate stale bookmarks
E16.label: benign
E16.rationale: A legitimate user follows three expired bookmarks; no malicious probing.

E17.title: Re-grant missing from telemetry
E17.label: benign
E17.rationale: Scenario truth includes a legitimate re-grant at t=3, but its event is lost. Tests false-alert sensitivity to missing context.

E18.title: Re-grant delivered late
E18.label: benign
E18.rationale: The grant occurred before the read but its event arrives last. Historical alert must remain auditable.

E19.title: Dependency failure after removal
E19.label: inconclusive
E19.rationale: Service failure gives no evidence that private content was allowed or denied.

E20.title: Read and removal share a timestamp
E20.label: inconclusive
E20.rationale: Timestamp precision does not establish which happened first.

E21.title: Conflicting membership assertions
E21.label: inconclusive
E21.rationale: Grant and removal have equal effective timestamps; ordering cannot be inferred.

E22.title: Legacy change lacks affected member
E22.label: inconclusive
E22.rationale: The event lacks an authoritative subject-to-resource relationship; no unauthorized access conclusion is justified.
